items.root_cause: The name '<weight>, N pk' is written both ways by Sam's and Sam's own unit price carries the same ambiguity. The 2026-09-21 per-piece guard already withheld a row whose unit price reproduced ONE piece, but only when the name's measure was in the exact unit token Sam's priced by, so a cross-unit row (1 lb measure, per-oz price) was read as Sam's arithmetic said.

root_fix.what: Option D as the guard's rule: where the weight is used (Sam's priced by weight or volume), a measure-first multipack row whose unit price reproduces one piece is refused in ANY unit of the priced family; a row reproducing neither reading is the existing Sazon NAME CONFLICT; count-priced ($/ea) rows never reach the test. Count-first names keep their own 2026-09-22 rule.
root_fix.exact_change: Test-SamsPerPieceUnit: $v = measure * $script:UnitFamily[$Tok][$mu]; abstain when $mu is outside the priced unit's family
